codex_contract.preserved_semantics: Use for "interrogate", "adversarial review", "multi-model review", "challenge this", "stress test this code", "find blind spots", or "tear this apart". Multiple LLM reviewers challenge changes from independent angles.

required_tools: native Codex subagents when delegated review is authorized
native_mapping.fallback: If fewer reviewers are available, report actual coverage and do not claim multi-model consensus.

external_dependencies: native subagent availability and operator-selected models
permission_gates: Respect explicit model selection and the standing model-capability-router.
Keep reviewer assignments read-only and prevent automatic edits.
Do not create a repair PR solely because a model name is unavailable.

behavioral_proof.positive: Fixture with two independent read-only reviewers on the same diff and a deduplicated verdict.
behavioral_proof.missing_tool_or_input: Unavailable models or reviewers are recorded as missing; no fabricated consensus.
behavioral_proof.error: A failed reviewer or inaccessible diff produces an explicit gap and no auto-applied patch.

upstream_readme.note: Verified in the pinned upstream clone; the README is referenced for provenance and is not vendored in this skills-only snapshot.

security_review.decision: Pinned source reviewed; native adapter does not waive the source findings.

codex_note:
## Codex runtime mapping

Use the native Codex subagent capability for independent read-only reviewers only when delegation is authorized. Follow the standing `model-capability-router` and the operator-selected model/effort; do not force the Cursor default model table. Record actual reviewer models and unavailable slots. Keep the source rubric, lead judgment, and no-auto-apply contract.
codex_rule: Preserve independent review and source rubric while respecting native model, scope and permissions.
preserved_requirement: Use for "interrogate", "adversarial review", "multi-model review", "challenge this", "stress test this code", "find blind spots", or "tear this apart". Multiple LLM reviewers challenge changes from independent angles.
proof: Pinned source hash and deterministic build are static provenance only; native multi-review behavior remains to be demonstrated.
reason: Replace Cursor Task and model config with native bounded reviewers while retaining the adversarial judgment workflow.

replacements.before: Launch all reviewers in a single message using the Task tool. Use the `interrogate reviewers` list from `~/.cursor/rules/pstack-models.mdc` when present, one reviewer per entry, extending or shrinking the Reviewer A/B/C/D labels below to the configured entry count. Otherwise use the table defaults.
replacements.after: Launch independent read-only reviewers through native Codex subagents when authorized. Use the actual available reviewers under the standing `model-capability-router` and the operator-selected model/effort; extend or shrink Reviewer A/B/C/D labels to match. Record unavailable reviewer slots.

- `model`: the configured `interrogate reviewers` entry, or the table default with no configured line

replacements.after:
- Assign a bounded review responsibility to each native subagent.
- Use a genuinely read-only role or instructions and verify no reviewer modified the workspace.
- Use native model selection only as allowed by the standing router and operator.

replacements.before: If a model slug is rejected as unresolvable when you try to spawn the subagent, check the valid slugs in the Task tool's error message, pick the closest equivalent (prefer the highest-reasoning tier of the same family), spawn with the valid slug, and open a separate PR to update the configured value or default table. Do not block the review on the slug issue. If the configured value is `inherit-parent` or `auto`, omit `model` instead. Never treat those aliases as broken slugs or enter this fallback for them.
replacements.after: If a requested model is unavailable, record that reviewer as unavailable. Continue with authorized available reviewers only when the proof bar can still be met. Do not silently substitute a model or create a repair PR.

replacements.before: **Identify consensus**. Findings raised by 2+ models independently are highest signal.
replacements.after: **Identify consensus**. Findings raised independently by 2+ actual reviewers are high signal; describe model diversity only when it was actually present.
